extra.message: Affected versions of aiohttp are vulnerable to Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling. The optimized C HTTP parser in aiohttp validates each fragment of an HTTP request/response line individually against max_line_size instead of the accumulated total. An attacker can split an oversized line across multiple network reads, bypassing the limit and causing excessive memory consumption, leading to denial of service. This affects both server-side request-target parsing and client-side response reason-phrase parsing.

cwe: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling

extra.message: Affected versions of aiohttp are vulnerable to Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling. aiohttp WebSocket endpoints fail to enforce the max_msg_size memory limit when a peer sends large incomplete WebSocket frame payloads. extra.message: Affected versions of cryptography are vulnerable to Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity. Missing subgroup validation in cryptography's SECT (binary) curve public‐key APIs: the functions public_key_from_numbers, EllipticCurvePublicNumbers.public_key(), load_der_public_key(), and load_pem_public_key() do not check that supplied points lie in the curve's prime‐order subgroup. An attacker can submit a small‐order subgroup point to leak bits of the victim's private key via ECDH shared‐secret computation or trivially forge ECDSA signatures on affected curves.

extra.message: Affected versions of cryptography are vulnerable to Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component / Out-of-bounds Read. The PyPI wheels for the cryptography package statically link a version of OpenSSL that contains security vulnerabilities (including a high-severity use-after-free in PKCS7_verify and several denial-of-service and forgery issues). Any application installed from an affected wheel ships the vulnerable OpenSSL binary, so an attacker may trigger out-of-bounds reads, crashes, or other memory-safety issues through cryptographic operations that reach the bundled OpenSSL code.

cwe: CWE-125: Out-of-bounds Read
CWE-1395: Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component
